title: Longest Palindrome You Can Build

concept.title: Use all the pairs, plus one middle letter
body: You may choose letters from a word (each letter at most as often as it occurs) and arrange them as a palindrome. Every letter that occurs `c` times gives `c // 2` **pairs**, which can all be placed symmetrically: that is `2 * (c // 2)` letters. In addition, if at least one letter has an odd count, one single letter can sit in the middle (+1).
Each letter contributes its even part, and there is only one middle position, so the "+1" is added at most once no matter how many letters have an odd count.

statement: Given a word, find the length of the longest palindrome that can be built using the letters of the word, each letter used at most as many times as it occurs. Upper and lower case letters are different.
hints: Pairs of equal letters can be placed on both sides of the middle.
A letter with count `c` gives `c - c % 2` letters in pairs.
If some letter has an odd count, add one more letter for the middle.

explanation: All pairs of equal letters are used; one leftover letter, if there is any, goes in the middle.
